name: Can design-build firms handle both interior and exterior remodels at once?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to do a whole-home interior and exterior remodel through one design-build team?
mainEntity.text: Is it better to do a whole-home interior and exterior remodel through one design-build team?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single design-build team can be a strong choice for whole-home remodels that include both interior and exterior work. That allows layout changes, structural upgrades, façade improvements, and outdoor living features to be planned together instead of in separate phases. In practice, this can create a more unified result and reduce rework. It is especially useful when interior changes affect windows, doors, roof openings, decks, or patios. The key challenge is defining scope clearly so the project does not become too large or too open-ended. Homeowners should confirm how the work will be phased, what spaces remain usable during construction, and how selections will be timed. A coordinated approach usually delivers the best result when the home needs both functional and visual transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, one design-build team can coordinate both interior and exterior remodels, which helps align structure, layout, finishes, and curb appeal. This approach is especially useful when changes inside affect windows, doors, rooflines, or outdoor living areas. The main challenge is scope control and sequencing.
